## 🩺 Client site uptime monitor
Every 15 minutes it requests each client site. A down or recovered site triggers one WhatsApp message via Twilio. State is kept in workflow static data, so you get one alert when a site goes down and one when it recovers, not one every 15 minutes.

**Note:** static data only persists when the workflow is **active**, not on manual test runs.
